intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Tampa for 2026, and here is what he found: 31 family events, 8 of them free. The magic runs from November 2 (Gingerbread Village at the Glazer Children's Museum) through January 4, 2027 (Christmas Town at Busch Gardens), with Santa Fest and Tree Lighting (December 5), the Victorian Christmas Stroll at the Henry B. Plant Museum (November 27 to December 31), Santa in Space at MOSI (December 12) and the Holiday Lighted Boat Parade (December 19) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Tampa

  • 31 Christmas events for kids in Tampa
  • 8 free events, including Santa Fest and Tree Lighting, Winter Village, The Holiday Promenade, Winter Wonder Wharf, Jingle Bell Bazaar Ybor and Santa Saturdays at Armature Works
  • Meet Santa: Santa Saturdays at Armature Works (November 28 and December 5, 12 and 19), Christmas Tidings at The Florida Aquarium, Santa in Space at MOSI (December 12) and Breakfast with Santa at Chick-fil-A Gandy Boulevard (December 5)
  • Parades and tree lightings: Santa Fest and Tree Lighting (December 5) and the Holiday Lighted Boat Parade (December 19)
  • Trains: the Christmas Train at South Tampa Fellowship Ballast Point (December 9) has train rides and pictures with Santa, and the free TECO Line Streetcar links downtown, the Channel District and Ybor City
  • Shows: Next Generation Ballet's Nutcracker at the Straz Center (December 18 to 22) and the Holiday Classics Movie Series at Tampa Theatre (November 29 to January 3)
  • Season: November 2 to January 4, 2027
